# `assets/humanoid/HandRigBuilder.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/HandRigBuilder.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/HandRigBuilder.js — build a hand rig for each hand of a humanoid. Priority: (1) use named finger bones if the skeleton has them; else (2) PROBE the hand mesh (vertices skinned to the hand joint) and GENERATE finger bones geometrically; else (3) a single paddle. Wrist + forward come from the humanoid rig (hand world position, and the lowerArm→hand direction).

## Functions

### `extractHandVertices(model, handNodeId, thresh = 0.4, pose = null)`

Vertices skinned (weight ≥ thresh) to the hand joint, in node-hierarchy SCENE space (so they match the wrist + the rendered mesh). `pose` is a node→world map.

### `buildHandRig(model, opts = {})`

Build a single hand rig.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel
- `opts` *(object)* — { side, handNode, lowerArmNode, world? }

**Returns:** HandRig

### `buildHands(model, opts = {})`

Build both hands for a model that already has a humanoid rig; attaches them at model.rigs.hand = { left, right } and humanoidRig.hands.

**Returns:** }
